content: अरि {%a.%} [ऋ-इन्] Moving, going, reaching; obtaining, aspiring, devoted to, zealous (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .{@-रिः@} .²1 An enemy, foe (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 4. 138</ls>); (used in the Veda like an adjective in the sense of ‘ungenerous’, ‘malicious’, ‘not worshipping or devoted’, ‘hostile’); विजितारिपुरःसरः <ls>R. 1. 59</ls>, <ls n="R. 1.">61</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 4</ls>. .²2 An enemy of mankind (said of the six feelings which disturb manʼs mind); कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो मदमोहौ च मत्सरः; कृतारिषड्वर्गजयेन <ls>Ki. 1. 9</ls>. .²3 A species of खदिर or Mimosa (विट्खदिर; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>शेण्या खैर</ns>). .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of the number six (from the six enemies). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a condition in astronomy. .²6 Any part of a carriage. .²7 A wheel, also a disk, अन्योऽन्यहस्तकलितैः कति मूर्तिभेदाः, शम्भोर्हरेरिव गदारिसरोजशङ्खैः <ls>Līlā.</ls> .²8 A lord, master. .²9 The wind. .²10 A pious or religious man.
